1.web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
1.asv: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.

2.web: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
2.asv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that, if ye receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

3.web: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
3.asv: Yea, I testify again to every man that receiveth circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

4.web: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
4.asv: Ye are severed from Christ, ye who would be justified by the law; ye are fallen away from grace.

5.web: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
5.asv: For we through the Spirit by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

6.web: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
6.asv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith working through love.

7.web: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
7.asv: Ye were running well; who hindered you that ye should not obey the truth?

8.web: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
8.asv: This persuasion came not of him that calleth you.

9.web: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
9.asv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

10.web: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
10.asv: I have confidence to you-ward in the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

11.web: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
11.asv: But I, brethren, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? then hath the stumbling-block of the cross been done away.

12.web: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
12.asv: I would that they that unsettle you would even go beyond circumcision.

13.web: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
13.asv: For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only use not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another.

14.web: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
14.asv: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, even in this: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.

15.web: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
15.asv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

16.web: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
16.asv: But I say, Walk by the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

17.web: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
17.asv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are contrary the one to the other; that ye may not do the things that ye would.

18.web: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
18.asv: But if ye are led by the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

19.web: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
19.asv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these: fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

20.web: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
20.asv: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousies, wraths, factions, divisions, parties,

21.web: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.
21.asv: envyings, drunkenness, revellings, and such like; of which I forewarn you, even as I did forewarn you, that they who practise such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

22.web: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
22.asv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

23.web: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
23.asv: meekness, self-control; against such there is no law.

24.web: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
24.asv: And they that are of Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with the passions and the lusts thereof.

25.web: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
25.asv: If we live by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us also walk.

26.web: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
26.asv: Let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
